message: Do not promise or confirm a payment arrangement at this stage. Arrangements require specialist authorisation.
Do not confirm that the resident is eligible for Council Tax Reduction. Signpost only — eligibility requires an assessment.
This is a higher-risk recovery stage. Do not make commitments beyond first-line scope. Consider escalation to the Revenues Specialist team.
Vulnerability-sensitive handling required. Slow the call pace, use supportive language, and consider specialist routing.
CRITICAL: Breathing Space has been mentioned. Stop all collection activity immediately and escalate to the specialist team.
Reminder: first-line agents cannot confirm arrangements, grant extensions, or make entitlement decisions without specialist involvement.
